user.title: Set up eBay
user.description: Automatic callback uses Home Assistant's native OAuth callback and is recommended. Manual authorization is an advanced fallback for troubleshooting browser callback problems.

prepare_application.title: Prepare your eBay application
prepare_application.description:
Open the eBay Developer Program application keys page:

{developer_console_url}

Use this Home Assistant OAuth callback URL for both eBay redirect fields:

`{callback_url}`

1. Select the production or sandbox environment you plan to use.
2. Scroll to "Get a Token from eBay via Your Application."
3. Under "Your eBay Sign-in Settings," click "Add eBay Redirect URL" or expand an existing redirect.
4. Set Display Title to a recognizable name, such as "Home Assistant."
5. If eBay asks for "Your privacy policy URL," you may use the project policy or your own: {privacy_policy_url}
6. Set both "Your auth accepted URL" and "Your auth declined URL" to the callback URL above.
7. Save the redirect and copy the generated RuName.
8. Return to Home Assistant and continue.

Do not use the "Sign in to Production" button under "Get a User Token Here." That creates a developer test token and is not the Home Assistant setup flow.

When Home Assistant later opens eBay authorization, sign in with the regular eBay account whose buying and selling activity you want to monitor. This may be different from your eBay Developer Program account.

Detailed setup guide: {oauth_setup_guide_url}

Authorization always requests the base eBay API scope and sell.analytics.readonly (Sell Analytics). Analytics enrichment can later be disabled in integration options without removing the granted scope.

credentials.title: Enter eBay application credentials
credentials.description: Production credentials must be paired with production. Sandbox credentials must be paired with sandbox. Site ID 0 is eBay United States.

data_description.client_id: Shown near the top of the eBay application keys page.
data_description.client_secret: The secret belonging to the same production or sandbox keyset.
data_description.runame: Generated by eBay after saving the redirect under "Your eBay Sign-in Settings." It usually looks like a long hyphenated identifier. It is not the Display Title and is not the callback URL.
data_description.site_id: Use 0 for eBay United States. See the setup guide for other site IDs.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthorize eBay
reauth_confirm.description: eBay rejected the stored refresh token. Continue to re-enter the Cert ID / Client secret and authorize again with the regular eBay account you want Home Assistant to monitor.

oauth.title: Authorize eBay
oauth.description:
Manual authorization is intended only when the automatic browser callback does not complete.

1. Open the consent URL below.
2. Sign into the regular eBay account you want Home Assistant to monitor.
3. Approve read-only access.
4. Paste the complete final callback URL below.
5. Paste only the authorization code if the full URL is unavailable.

Pasting the full callback URL allows Home Assistant to validate OAuth state.

This consent always requests the base API scope and Sell Analytics read-only access. You can disable Analytics enrichment later in options without revoking the granted scope.

{consent_url}

error.cannot_connect: Could not exchange the authorization code with eBay.
error.invalid_state: The callback URL state does not match this setup session.

abort.oauth_timeout: Timed out while authorizing with eBay.

data_description.per_item_cap: Limits the number of selected item listings. Each selected listing can create multiple Home Assistant entities depending on item type.
data_description.pinned_item_price_targets: One target per line: item_id=amount CURRENCY. Item IDs must also appear in pinned item IDs. Per-item targets override the global threshold.
data_description.watched_price_change_min_percent: Minimum absolute percent change required before directional watched-price events fire. Use 0 to emit on any numeric change.
data_description.watched_price_drop_threshold: Optional global amount. Leave blank to disable. Compared only against listings in the matching currency.
data_description.watched_price_drop_currency: Required when a global threshold is set. Normalized to uppercase (for example USD).

error.invalid_price_target: Each line must be item_id=amount CURRENCY with a nonnegative amount.
error.duplicate_price_target: Each pinned item ID may appear only once in price targets.
error.target_not_pinned: Price target item IDs must also be listed in pinned item IDs.
